newsitem.title: USA: American Oilfield unit extends buyout bid.
newsitem.headline: American Oilfield unit extends buyout bid.

text.p: AOD Acquisition Corp, a unit of American Oilfield Divers Inc, said Wednesday it extended its offer to acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares of Hard Suits Inc, at a price of C$1.50 per share/US$1.095 per share, until October 30.
AOD said a C$2.5 million loan agreement reached by Hard Suits subsequent to AOD's offer is "contrary to the best interests of existing shareholders of Hard Suits."

According to AOD, the loan would carry an average interest rate of 14 percent, have a redemption premium which could be as high as 100 percent, and includes warrants which, when exercised, represent more than 27 percent of the outstanding common shares.
In a released statement, AOD's Chief Executive George Yax said, "The terms of this loan are outrageous. The loan only benefits the management and advisors of Hard Suits."
Yax said AOD believes it is in the best interest of Hard Suits' shareholders to tender their shares.
